targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Users" FROM users;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Active Users Today"
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
  AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cp.final_prize_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS "Total Prize Pool"
FROM contests c
JOIN contest_participants cp ON c.id = cp.contest_id
WHERE c.status IN ('running', 'registration_open', 'scheduled');

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "New Users"
FROM users
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)
ORDER BY time;

WITH daily_active AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS day,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau
  FROM orders
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)
),
monthly_active AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS mau
  FROM orders
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT
  d.day AS time,
  CASE WHEN m.mau > 0 THEN d.dau::float / m.mau ELSE 0 END AS "DAU/MAU Ratio"
FROM daily_active d
CROSS JOIN monthly_active m
ORDER BY d.day;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS time,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) AS hour,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM users
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at)
ORDER BY time, hour;

SELECT
  u.email,
  COUNT(cp.contest_id) AS contests_joined,
  COALESCE(SUM(cp.final_prize_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS total_winnings,
  MIN(cp.joined_at) AS first_joined,
  MAX(cp.joined_at) AS last_joined
FROM users u
JOIN contest_participants cp ON u.id = cp.user_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.email
ORDER BY contests_joined DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM contests
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT
  c.name AS contest_name,
  COUNT(cp.user_id) AS participants
FROM contests c
LEFT JOIN contest_participants cp ON c.id = cp.contest_id
WHERE ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest)
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY participants DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH contest_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.id,
    COUNT(cp.user_id) AS current_participants,
    100 AS max_participants -- Assumed max, adjust based on actual limit
  FROM contests c
  LEFT JOIN contest_participants cp ON c.id = cp.contest_id
  WHERE c.status IN ('running', 'registration_open')
    AND ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest)
  GROUP BY c.id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(max_participants) > 0
    THEN (SUM(current_participants)::float / SUM(max_participants)) * 100
    ELSE 0
  END AS "Fill Rate %"
FROM contest_stats;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) AS time,
  AVG(entry_fee_cents) / 100.0 AS "Avg Entry Fee"
FROM contests
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "Orders"
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR contest_id::text = $contest)
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  symbol,
  SUM(qty) AS volume
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR contest_id::text = $contest)
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
    THEN (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side = 'buy')::float / COUNT(*)) * 100
    ELSE 50
  END AS "Buy %"
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR contest_id::text = $contest);

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(qty), 2) AS "Avg Order Size"
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR contest_id::text = $contest);

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(c.entry_fee_cents * participant_count), 0) / 100.0 AS "Total Entry Fees"
FROM contests c
JOIN (
  SELECT contest_id, COUNT(*) AS participant_count
  FROM contest_participants
  GROUP BY contest_id
) cp ON c.id = cp.contest_id
WHERE ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest);

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(final_prize_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS "Total Prizes Paid"
FROM contest_participants cp
JOIN contests c ON cp.contest_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'completed'
  AND cp.final_prize_cents IS NOT NULL
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest);

WITH fees AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.entry_fee_cents * participant_count), 0) AS total_fees
  FROM contests c
  JOIN (
    SELECT contest_id, COUNT(*) AS participant_count
    FROM contest_participants
    GROUP BY contest_id
  ) cp ON c.id = cp.contest_id
  WHERE ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest)
),
prizes AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_prize_cents), 0) AS total_prizes
  FROM contest_participants cp
  JOIN contests c ON cp.contest_id = c.id
  WHERE c.status = 'completed'
    AND cp.final_prize_cents IS NOT NULL
    AND ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest)
)
SELECT (f.total_fees - p.total_prizes) / 100.0 AS "Net Revenue"
FROM fees f, prizes p;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN final_prize_cents IS NOT NULL AND final_prize_cents > 0 THEN 'Paid'
    WHEN final_rank IS NOT NULL AND final_rank <= 10 THEN 'Pending'
    ELSE 'Not Eligible'
  END AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM contest_participants cp
JOIN contests c ON cp.contest_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'completed'
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest)
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN final_prize_cents IS NOT NULL AND final_prize_cents > 0 THEN 'Paid'
    WHEN final_rank IS NOT NULL AND final_rank <= 10 THEN 'Pending'
    ELSE 'Not Eligible'
  END;

WITH daily_fees AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', c.created_at) AS day,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.entry_fee_cents * participant_count), 0) AS fees
  FROM contests c
  JOIN (
    SELECT contest_id, COUNT(*) AS participant_count
    FROM contest_participants
    GROUP BY contest_id
  ) cp ON c.id = cp.contest_id
  WHERE c.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', c.created_at)
),
daily_prizes AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', c.ends_at) AS day,
    COALESCE(SUM(cp.final_prize_cents), 0) AS prizes
  FROM contest_participants cp
  JOIN contests c ON cp.contest_id = c.id
  WHERE c.status = 'completed'
    AND c.ends_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', c.ends_at)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(f.day, p.day) AS time,
  (COALESCE(f.fees, 0) - COALESCE(p.prizes, 0)) / 100.0 AS "Daily Revenue"
FROM daily_fees f
FULL OUTER JOIN daily_prizes p ON f.day = p.day
ORDER BY time;

SELECT total_score AS score
FROM contest_participants cp
JOIN contests c ON cp.contest_id = c.id
WHERE ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest)
  AND c.status IN ('running', 'completed');

SELECT
  taken_at AS time,
  AVG((entry->>'score')::numeric) AS "Avg Score"
FROM leaderboard_snapshots,
  jsonb_array_elements(payload_json->'entries') AS entry
WHERE taken_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND taken_at <= $__timeTo()
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR contest_id::text = $contest)
GROUP BY taken_at
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  u.email,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.final_rank = 1) AS contest_wins,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.final_rank <= 3) AS top_3_finishes,
  COUNT(*) AS contests_entered,
  COALESCE(SUM(cp.final_prize_cents), 0) / 100.0 AS total_earnings,
  ROUND(AVG(cp.final_rank), 1) AS avg_rank
FROM users u
JOIN contest_participants cp ON u.id = cp.user_id
JOIN contests c ON cp.contest_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'completed'
  AND cp.final_rank IS NOT NULL
  AND ($contest = 'all' OR c.id::text = $contest)
GROUP BY u.id, u.email
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY contest_wins DESC, total_earnings DESC
LIMIT 20;
